Young college-age man in side profile, medium brown skin, short black fade hair, purple #4B2C7F quarter-zip sweater with charcoal chest panel and teal #4DB6AC collar trim, charcoal tapered trousers and canvas sneakers. He studies a tablet held in one arm showing a lavender-tinted screen with an ascending teal candlestick trend line and one violet highlighted cluster, tracing it with a stylus in his other hand; a small brass-rimmed magnifying glass floats near the highlighted bars and a loose printed chart page peeks from under his arm. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Subtle Investigative RIASEC teal accent on trend line and cuff.
